title: Replication competent HIV-guided CRISPR screen identifies antiviral factors including targets of the accessory protein Nef
model: CEM-M7 CD4+ T cell line, replication-competent HIV-1 guide library (~511 host genes)
contrast: 15 dpi vs virus-stock input, untreated, 3 independent infections (3 vs 3)
paper_calls: GRN, CIITA, EHMT2, CEACAM3, CC2D1B, RHOA enriched >50-fold over passaging
named_hits: All six named enrichment hits recovered: EHMT2 #1, CEACAM3 #8, CC2D1B #15, CIITA #91, GRN #96, RHOA #109
verdict: Raw reads recovered exactly from the MAGeCK-normalized table. After median-ratio normalization for the strong passaging shift, BARCS recovers all six antiviral factors the paper names as enriched, with EHMT2 the top hit.
count_recovery: Raw reads = normalized / (one scale factor per sample); integrality 100.0%.
